story: Gene banks aren’t enough to save the world’s food
text: I recently came across the videos of Oregon State horticulturalist Andrew Millison, who is an amazingly clear presenter about permaculture: [LINK] For example, he has nice videos about chinampas in Mexico [VIDEO] , a medieval Indian canal tunnel of a style found throughout Iran [LINK] , efforts to return a Hawaiian watershed to something like its historical state [LINK] , the Indian Paani Foundation's "water cup" to revitalize drought stricken villages [LINK] , and the difficulty of using ancient iron-saturated aquifers for irrigation in western Egypt [LINK]

story: A Dutch graphic artist reconstructed Tenochtitlan in 3D
text: The chinampas are a super neat example of agroforestry. The soil is extremely dark (like Ukrainian chernozem or better) and has a very low depletion per cycle. Some still exist and are being stewarded toward renewal and proliferation! [LINK] [VIDEO]
